answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before joining, tied to one hardware-backed identity attested by a quorum of validators, so a walnut-sized stake cannot buy a vote: many tiny stakes from one actor cannot outvote one large honest stake. At the zenith of each epoch, randomly audit a sample of identities and slash stakes whose attestations fail, so a sybil farm must pay fresh stake for every fake identity. Honest agents keep their knoll of reputation and earn fees, while attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making large-scale forgery uneconomic.
